Night 01 / North Reef
\n

Bring them
home.

\n

\n The fog is thick. Ships are running in from the open sea and they follow\n the light on the water. Sweep the beam, chart the reef,\n and lead each one into the harbor before the rocks find them.\n

\n
\n
01
Move the pointer to swing the beam. It carries weight — it lags.
\n
02
A ship turns toward your lead mark only while your light is on it.
\n
03
Press Space for full light to chart the whole reef at once.
\n
\n
\n \n \n
\n
\n

The night watch

\n

LEAD MARK — where your beam meets the water. Every lit ship steers toward it.

\n

SHOALS — hidden in the fog. Sweep them to chart them; a charted mark stays on the water.

\n

HARBOR — the amber ring between the breakwaters. Get a ship inside it and it's home.

\n

TIME — the night runs two minutes. Unfinished ships are lost to the fog.

\n
\n
Pointer / drag · Arrow keys · Space · Esc
\n

How to play

\n

Classic Klondike, draw three.

\n
    \n
  1. 1Build the four foundations from Ace to King by suit.
    2. \n
  2. 2Build tableau piles in descending order and alternating colors.
    3. \n
  3. 3Only a King can fill an empty tableau slot.
    4. \n
  4. 4Draw three cards from the stock. When the stock is empty, recycle the waste.
    5. \n
  5. 5Click or drag cards to move them. Undo restores the exact previous state.
    6. \n
  6. 6Win when all four foundations reach the King.
    7. \n
\n
